title: Where Is Your Nose? 🤔 Nose, Ears, Tummy & Toes with Baby Jimmy | Learn Body Parts | Crayon Babies
description:
Where is your nose? 🤔 Baby Jimmy sings all four body parts in his cozy bedroom – nose, ears, tummy and toes – then asks you to find your nose! Can you touch it?

🎬 What happens in this video:
👃 "Nose! Boop! Ears! Listen!"
🤗 "Tummy! Pat, pat! Toes! Wiggle, wiggle!"
🤔 "Where is your nose? Hmm?" – touch your nose!
🎉 "There it is! Boop! Yay! You did it!"
💃 Nose and ears, tummy and toes – dance with Jimmy!
👋 "Bye bye, friends! Boop!"

📚 Kids learn: body parts • nose • ears • tummy • toes • English words: touch, listen, pat, wiggle

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A fun sing-along body parts review for toddlers and preschoolers – touch your nose, listen with your ears, pat your tummy and wiggle your toes with Baby Jimmy to learn body parts in English.

Kids songs • Nursery rhymes • Body parts song • Learn English for kids • Toddler learning • Preschool learning • Kids cartoon
